item.title: VISIT PA is Partnering with the World Champion Philadelphia Eagles to Inspire Fans to Explore Pennsy
item.description: For the first time ever, VISIT PA is partnering with the Philadelphia Eagles to help drive fans beyond the football field to experience Pennsylvania, The Great American Getaway. This partnership builds on driving tourism into the greater Pennsylvania area.
